attacks.name: Bo Staff
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
This character may reroll any number of attack dice for this attack.
|!critical| |!wild| |!hit| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

attacks.name: Throwing Crescents
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

|!hit| |*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make 1 additional |*Throwing Crescents| attack. The additional attack must target the original defender. The additional attack does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

attacks.name: Avatar of Khonshu
steps: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.
|*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 2 or less, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Chosen of Khonshu
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!mystic| attack, it may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to this character's defense roll against that attack. This character cannot be Advanced, Pushed, or Placed by the effects of this attack.

superPowers.name: Multiple Personalities
superPowers.body: At the start of this character's Activation, roll 1 die. If the result is a |!critical|, this character may make an additional action this turn that must be a move action. If the result is a |!wild| or a |!hit|, the next attack made this activation adds 2 dice to its attack roll. If the result is a |!block| or a Blank, this character gains 1 |!power|. If the result is a |!failure|, there is no effect.
